Formal names of a nickname

Source: R/nicknames.R
get_formal_names.Rd

Formal names of a nickname

Usage

get_formal_names(x, gender = NULL, gender_confidence = NULL, sep = ";; ")

Arguments

x

Character vector of first names.

gender

Optional vector of "M", "F" or "U", as returned by parse_name(), used to choose among formal names.

gender_confidence

Optional vector of gender confidence (0-100), as returned by parse_name().

sep

Separator for the list columns. Defaults to ";; ".

Value

Character vector: the formal forms of each name, most used first, or "" if none.

Examples

get_formal_names(c("BOB", "PAT", "PAT"), gender = c("M", "F", "M"),
                 gender_confidence = 99)
#> [1] "ROBERT"           "PATRICIA;; PATSY" "PATRICK"
